preconditions.description: Number of students n is between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= fi <= n and fi != i for i, (fi, si) in enumerate(students, start=1))
preconditions.description: Each student's best friend index fi is between 1 and n, and not equal to the student's own index i.

preconditions.expression: all(si in {1, 2} for _, si in students)
preconditions.description: Each student's sex si is either 1 (boy) or 2 (girl).

postconditions.description: The number of pairs t is equal to the length of the pairs list.

postconditions.expression: e == sum((si == 1 and sj == 2) or (si == 2 and sj == 1) for (i, si), (j, sj) in pairs)
postconditions.description: The number of boy-girl pairs e is the count of pairs where one student is a boy and the other is a girl.
No student is paired with themselves.

postconditions.expression: all((i, j) in pairs or (j, i) in pairs for i, (fi, si) in enumerate(students, start=1) for j, (fj, sj) in enumerate(students, start=1) if fi == j and fj == i)
postconditions.description: If student i's best friend is student j and vice versa, then (i, j) or (j, i) is a pair.

postconditions.expression: all((i, j) in pairs or (j, i) in pairs for i, (fi, si) in enumerate(students, start=1) for j, (fj, sj) in enumerate(students, start=1) if fi == j and fj != i)
postconditions.description: If student i's best friend is student j and student j's best friend is not student i, then (i, j) or (j, i) is a pair.
